task: Resolve the exact U03 rehearsal modify conflict on current main through a separately governed main resolution that preserves immutable U03 intent, adds the exact missing fixture-25 source artifact, and records the deterministic release-unit conflict-resolution receipt bound to the reviewed resolved blob.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #225 replayed immutable parent source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 on current main 6c897234b6c890f8ee38f86c08dc86f7b9f68fa2. U01 and U02 are already closed. U03 now fails at the intended downstream materializer with RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT on tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts. The exact immutable U03 source intent is small and reviewable: create fixture-25.json and extend the production-surface test so the bounded rehearsal fixture corpus is exactly fixture-01..25 with the canonical fixture contract. The generic receipt infrastructure from PR #1096 requires a separately governed main resolution whose reviewed target blob is bound by an exact deterministic receipt. Current main does not yet contain fixture-25 or the corpus test.
observableOutcomes: The resolution branch starts from exact main 6c897234b6c890f8ee38f86c08dc86f7b9f68fa2.
fixture-25.json is byte-for-byte identical to immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65.
tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts preserves all current-main evolution and adds only the U03 corpus-contract intent plus the required readdirSync import.
The exact receipt is written only at the deterministic path emitted by Release Unit Execution #225.
The receipt binds releaseUnitId, file, source parent, source commit and source patch digest exactly to the persisted blocker.
resolutionBaseSha is the pre-resolution main SHA and resolvedBlobSha/fileMode bind the reviewed resolved test file in the resolution commit.
The resolution PR passes normal Plan/Edit-Time/Replay/Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Truth/Lifecycle proof before merge.

After merge, immutable source replay treats fixture-25 create and the conflict-resolved modify as exact already-applied operations, runs the full no-code child proof and closes U03 without manual child-PR edits or release-state mutation.
unresolvedRisks: Resolving by simply preserving target content would silently drop immutable U03 corpus-test intent.
Replacing the current test file with the old source version would delete substantial later main evolution.
Adding the corpus test without fixture-25 would intentionally make the resolution PR CI fail.
A receipt whose resolvedBlobSha is computed from a different test blob would become invalid or unsafe.
Any later edit to the resolved test file before U03 replay invalidates the receipt and must fail closed.
The stale U03 child PR #1074 must not be manually repaired or treated as proof authority.

in: Create quality/knowledge/rehearsal-fixtures/v1/fixture-25.json with exact immutable source content.
Merge the immutable corpus-contract test intent into the current main production-surface test without removing current assertions.
Create the deterministic shoporation.release-unit-conflict-resolution.v1 receipt at the exact path emitted by the live blocker.
Bind the receipt to the resolved test blob created by this governed resolution transaction.
Replay the immutable rehearsal only after the resolution merges.
out: No edit to release-unit runtime or executor code.
No edit to the immutable source branch.
No manual U03 child PR repair.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This transaction is the human-governed semantic merge authority for one exact fail-closed release-unit conflict. It must preserve both immutable U03 intent and current-main evolution while producing a receipt that cannot authorize any other blob.

acceptanceCriteria: The current-main test file remains structurally intact except for adding readdirSync and the bounded rehearsal fixture corpus test.
The corpus test expects exactly fixture-01.json through fixture-25.json and validates contract, fixtureId, ordinal, purpose and runtimeImpact for every fixture.
fixture-25.json exactly matches immutable source content and source blob identity.
Receipt resolutionBaseSha is 6c897234b6c890f8ee38f86c08dc86f7b9f68fa2, an ancestor of the merged target.
Receipt resolvedBlobSha equals the exact Git blob SHA of the resolved test content in the resolution commit and resolvedFileMode is 100644.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
Post-merge immutable source replay advances beyond RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT and closes U03 only through the canonical already-applied proof path.
invariants: Immutable source intent is preserved; no source assertion is silently discarded.
Current-main test evolution is preserved; no historical source file replacement is allowed.
The receipt never contains executable file content.
The receipt identifies only one exact conflict and one exact reviewed resolved blob.
fixture-25 source content is not rewritten or synthesized.
No stale child branch is mutated.

failureModes: Current-main test content is accidentally replaced by the historical source file.
Corpus test lands without fixture-25 and CI fails.
Receipt is authored before resolved blob identity is known and points to the old target blob.
Receipt path or source patch identity differs from live #225 blocker.
A later edit changes the resolved file blob before replay and the receipt becomes stale.
Resolution merge succeeds but U03 no-code proof exposes another dependency/Truth blocker.
edgeCases: readdirSync is already imported under a grouped node:fs import and must be added without duplicate imports
the current test file has many later assertions after the historical source hunk
fixture-25 path does not exist on current main
source fixture content has trailing newline
receipt and resolved test file are created in the same atomic implementation commit
post-resolution main advances in unrelated files before replay while resolved blob remains unchanged
post-resolution main changes the resolved test file before replay

alternatives.summary: Add exact fixture-25, merge only the source corpus-test intent into current main, and bind the reviewed resolved blob with the deterministic receipt.
alternatives.reason: Preserves both immutable source intent and later main evolution while using the canonical conflict continuation path.

alternatives.summary: Create only the receipt pointing at unchanged current-main test content.
alternatives.reason: Would silently discard the immutable U03 corpus-test intent.

specialistReviews.resolution: Scope is fixed to the exact live conflict, immutable fixture and deterministic receipt; no runtime changes or other files are authorized.

specialistReviews.finding: Receipt identity must not authorize an unreviewed blob.
specialistReviews.resolution: resolvedBlobSha is generated from the exact resolved test blob in the implementation commit and file mode is fixed to 100644.

specialistReviews.finding: Both source intent and later current-main assertions must survive.
specialistReviews.resolution: Apply only the 18-line corpus-test intent to the current 66KB test file and preserve all existing content.

specialistReviews.finding: U01 and U02 are closed; U03 is final and blocked only on the exact modify conflict.
specialistReviews.resolution: Merge governed resolution, replay immutable source, require already-applied full proof and parent closure.

specialistReviews.finding: The conflict is now exact and reproducible with deterministic receipt path.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the identity in plan/proof and allow no generic conflict resolution behavior.

challenge.finding: That blob does not contain the reviewed merged resolution.
challenge.resolution: Compute resolvedBlobSha from the new merged test content blob and bind receipt to it.

challenge.finding: Executor must reject the resolution as a different conflict.
challenge.resolution: Use exact live blocker values without normalization.

challenge.resolution: Materializer exact-blob idempotency treats it as alreadyApplied; no duplicate commit is created.

challenge.finding: Expected because current file includes later main evolution.

Canonical no-code proof runs full guards/Truth/Lifecycle and emits a no-code main receipt before unit closure.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before any resolution content is written.
Build the resolved test from the exact current-main file plus the immutable U03 corpus-test delta; do not replace the file wholesale.
Create fixture-25 from immutable source bytes.
Create the exact receipt in the same atomic implementation commit using the resolved test Git blob SHA returned by Git object creation.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Replay/Release Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof.
Merge only after exact PR-head SUCCESS and green main CI.
Replay immutable source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require U03 ALREADY_APPLIED full proof plus parent closure.

requirements.requirement: The exact U03 modify conflict must be resolved on main by preserving immutable corpus-test intent and current-main evolution, with the reviewed resolved blob cryptographically bound to the deterministic conflict receipt.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The immutable U03 corpus-test intent may not be omitted from the reviewed resolution.
Later current-main production-surface assertions may not be removed by the resolution.
The conflict receipt may not point at a blob other than the exact reviewed resolved test file.
